text:
maya (oncall): FYI - after the BMC fw roll to 2.1.0 in ap-southeast2 ~12 GPU nodes lost OOB (IPMI/serial) access and are stuck in provisioning. Autoscaler keeps creating replacements, cost is spiking. Anyone seeing this?
chris (infra): seeing it. `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.2.4.X chassis status` returns connection refused on the affected range. Switch shows lots of TIME_WAIT/conntrack entries for the OOB subnet.
priya (fw): 2.1.0 enabled IPMI session keepalive by default (to reduce churn). looks like it interacts badly with the ap-se2 switch TCP idle timeout -> conntrack table saturation and new connections get dropped.
maya (oncall): runbook? rollback full fw fleet is not an option during business hours. we need a quick targeted workaround.
juan (provisioning): possible short-term fixes: drop stale conntrack entries, add iptables rules to accept/refresh sessions, or flip the keepalive flag on the affected BMCs. flipping per-host setting seems safest. can we push config via sysfw agent?
chris (infra): quick check I ran on one affected node: after forcing `conntrack -D --orig-src 10.2.4.45` the ipmi session came back and the provisioning job resumed. reproducible.

```
# quick diagnostic I ran
conntrack -L | grep 10.2.4.0/24 | wc -l
# -> 842 (table filled)

# manual delete for one host
conntrack -D --orig-src 10.2.4.45
```

priya (fw): we can ship a targeted config patch to disable `bmc.ipmi_keepalive` for ap-se2 hosts. I'll prepare a canary for 2 nodes first.
juan (provisioning): command we can use for the patch (tested against staging):

```
redwood-oobctl set bmc.ipmi_keepalive=false --hosts $(cat /tmp/affected-nodes)
```

chris (infra): I ran that on `redwood-gpu-1234` as a test. OOB came back in ~40s, provisioning continued. good signal.
maya (oncall): agree we do targeted change. Priya - can you create the patch + precheck script and roll to the 2-node canary, then remaining 10? post steps in runbook and include conntrack mitigation if hit again.
priya (fw): on it. pushing to staging canary now, ETA 15m for canary verification then batch to the rest if green. I'll also add a post-rollout check to flush conntrack on the switches if needed.
juan (provisioning): also recommend pausing the autoscaler launch to avoid more inflight replacements and cost bleed. switch traffic to reserved pool.
maya (oncall): pausing autoscaler now, moving traffic to reserved. keep this thread updated. tagging postmortem when we close. :pray:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: config-patch deployment started at 2050001300. canary hosts: redwood-gpu-1234, redwood-gpu-5678. Will post status on completion.
maya (oncall): update - canary success, OOB restored on both, provisioning resumed. Priya, please proceed with remaining 10. leaving open until all green. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
